# HTML validation for the source-checks workflow: W3C Nu validator via html5validator (bundles vnu.jar;
# needs a Java runtime, present on ubuntu-24.04 runners). Hash-pinned; the package ships only an sdist, built
# with --no-build-isolation against the hash-pinned requirements-build.txt. The sdist hash also pins the bundled
# vnujar/vnu.jar; the workflow re-checks that jar's sha256 (VNU_JAR_SHA256) after install.
